verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents a built-in MCP server for browsing issues, inspecting stack traces, and resolving issues, plus a Sentry-compatible API, which supports agent-driven pulling and triage of production errors. However, there is no evidence of any integration or workflow for filing resulting bugs into an external issue tracker (e.g., Jira/GitHub), and no OpenAPI spec was found (404s), limiting programmatic API discoverability. missing for 10: tracker-filing integration (e.g., GitHub/Jira issue creation), published OpenAPI/schema for the API, independent confirmation of MCP triage-to-ticket workflow.
